title: Add QR scan redirect system to send users to the portfolio URL

requirements.text: Add a new public route `/scan` that immediately redirects the user to `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/` after the page loads, and show a simple on-screen message while the redirect is happening (English only).

quotes: I need a scanner system that redirects users to my portfolio after scanning

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/scan` triggers a client-side redirect to `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/` without requiring any user interaction.
While redirecting, the page renders an English message such as "Redirecting to portfolio…" so users are not staring at a blank screen.
The redirect does not create an infinite loop and does not redirect back to `/scan`.

requirements.text: Add a new public route `/qr` that displays a QR code image that encodes `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/` and includes a short English instruction text (e.g., "Scan to open my portfolio").

quotes: I need a scanner system that redirects users to my portfolio after scanning

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting `/qr` shows a QR code image that, when scanned by a phone camera, opens `https://dynamic-developer-portfolio-with-public-site-and-a-w6e.caffeine.xyz/`.
The QR page includes clear English instructions and displays the destination URL as readable text.
The QR code image is served as a static asset from `frontend/public/assets/generated/` (not generated dynamically via backend calls).
The `/qr` page is responsive and looks acceptable on mobile and desktop.

requirements.text: Ensure utility routes `/scan` and `/qr` are marked as `noindex, nofollow` via the existing route-aware SEO head manager behavior, so search engines do not index these utility pages.

quotes: I need a scanner system that redirects users to my portfolio after scanning

acceptanceCriteria: When visiting `/scan` and `/qr`, the page includes `meta[name="robots"]` set to `noindex, nofollow`.
Public SEO behavior for existing portfolio pages remains unchanged.
Admin route SEO behavior remains unchanged.

constraints: Frontend must not modify any paths listed in `SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths` (compose existing UI components instead).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not integrate any third-party ad network scripts, trackers, or external QR-code generation APIs.
nonGoals: Building a native mobile scanner app.
Implementing camera access or an in-browser QR scanner (the requirement is redirect after scanning an external QR code).
Changing the portfolio content/pages beyond adding the new `/scan` and `/qr` utility routes.
Adding `/scan` or `/qr` to `sitemap.xml` (they are utility pages and should not be indexed).
